headerDisplay: Read-only Northbound/OpenAPI monitoring. A normal FusionSolar app password is insufficient. Extended measurements are intended for Controller for HomeKit; Apple Home shows selected standard sensors. The plugin does not control the inverter.

baseUrl.title: FusionSolar server (HTTPS)
baseUrl.description: Your account server, for example https://eu5.fusionsolar.huawei.com. Verify your region; the example is not automatic region selection.

username.title: Northbound/OpenAPI username
username.description: May be omitted when FUSIONSOLAR_USERNAME is set in the Homebridge service environment.

password.title: Northbound/OpenAPI password
password.description: May be omitted when FUSIONSOLAR_PASSWORD is set. Homebridge stores values entered here in its configuration.

stationCodes.title: Selected plant identifiers
stationCodes.description: Optional. An empty list selects all assigned plants (up to 100). Use API plantCode, for example NE=12345678.

pollIntervalSeconds.title: Polling interval (seconds)
pollIntervalSeconds.description: Delay after each cycle finishes. Huawei usually refreshes data every five minutes. Integrations on the same account share API quotas.

alarms.title: Read active alarms
alarms.description: Polled every 30 minutes. Cleared alarm history is not returned.

statusSensors.title: Virtual sensors in Apple Home
statusSensors.description: Contact sensors indicate a plant fault or positive PV production. They are virtual indicators, not physical contacts.

writeSnapshot.title: Local full-reading snapshot
writeSnapshot.description: Writes latest readings and full alarm descriptions under huawei-fusionsolar-monitor in Homebridge storage. Owner-only file permissions; excludes passwords and tokens.

demo.title: Demo mode (synthetic data)
demo.description: Shows synthetic data without Huawei connections or an API account. Real credentials are required after disabling demo.

powerMeters.title: Power measurement services
powerMeters.description: Adds PV Production, signed Grid Power and, when explicitly configured, Grid Import/Export and estimated Home Consumption inside existing accessories. Original metrics remain available when disabled.

gridPowerDirection.title: Grid meter power direction
gridPowerDirection.description: Unconfigured never guesses direction. Choosing positiveImport or positiveExport confirms the selected meter measures the grid connection and its positive-power direction. Applies to all selected plants. Verify night/import and export against FusionSolar.

gridMeterId.title: Grid meter device ID (optional)
gridMeterId.description: Exact decimal device ID as a string. Omit for automatic selection of the unique plant meter. Use to resolve multiple meters; no whitespace or numeric values.
